dataset.description: Simulated student food diaries (see ml/simulate.py); retrain on real diaries as they accumulate.

clusters.name: Sugary-drink lover
clusters.description: Much of the day's sugar comes from soft drinks, juices and snacks.
clusters.tip: Swap one soft drink a day for water. One 500 ml soft drink has about 53 g of sugar.

clusters.name: Balanced eater
clusters.description: Regular meals with a good mix of energy, protein and fibre.
clusters.tip: Keep it up. Add a fruit or a side salad on busy days to stay on track.

clusters.name: Meal skipper
clusters.description: Breakfast and lunch are often missed, so the body runs short of energy and protein.
clusters.tip: Start with a quick breakfast (porridge, eggs or a peanut butter sandwich) before lectures.

clusters.name: Fast-food & late-night eater
clusters.description: Fried foods such as chips and burgers make up many meals, portions are large and eating often happens late at night.
clusters.tip: Choose rice or sadza instead of chips twice a week, add a vegetable side and keep late-night snacks small.
